title: The First Victory
summary: Ha-Jun spares Captain Baek and shows him Tae-Jun's journal, exposing the Bureau Director's treason. Captain Baek allows Ha-Jun and Min-Jae to escape. As Arc 2 concludes at 25% Synchronization, an Envoy of the Demon Lords watches from the shadows, and the next Relic—Bone of the Forgotten—begins to resonate.

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands panting in the rubble, raising his left hand: The crystalline blood spears pinning Captain Baek liquefy into scarlet streams.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands panting in the rubble, raising his left hand: The crystalline blood spears pinning Captain Baek liquefy into scarlet streams.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun malbe mein hanfta hua khada hai, apna bayan haath upar utha raha hai: captain bak ko pakadne wale crystaliy rakt bhale lal rang ki dharaon mein dravibhut ho rahe han.

panels.shot: blood absorbing into silver ring macro
panels.action: The scarlet streams flow smoothly back into the Ring of Hollow Blood on Ha-Jun's finger, leaving Captain Baek free of physical restraint.
panels.prose_en: The scarlet streams flow smoothly back into the Ring of Hollow Blood on Ha-Jun's finger, leaving Captain Baek free of physical restraint.
panels.prose_hi: Lal rang ki dharayen ha-jun ki ungli par ring off hollow blood mein aasani se pravahit hoti han, jisse captain bake sharirik sanyam se mukt ho jaate han.

panels.shot: captain baek collapsing on one knee
panels.action: Captain Baek collapses to one knee, clutching his bleeding shoulder, staring up at Ha-Jun in absolute, stunned bewilderment.
panels.prose_en: Captain Baek collapses to one knee, clutching his bleeding shoulder, staring up at Ha-Jun in absolute, stunned bewilderment.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bak ek ghutne par gir jata hai, apne khoon bahte kandhe ko pakdkar, ha-jun ko puri tarah se stabdh hokar ghurta hai.

panels.action: Baek speaks in a hoarse, ragged voice: 'Kyun...? Tumne mujhe khatam kyun nahi kiya? Tumhare paas aakhri vaar tha.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Kyun...? Tumne mujhe maar kyun nahi diya?

panels.prose_en: Baek speaks in a hoarse, ragged voice: 'Kyun...? Tumne mujhe khatam kyun nahi kiya? Tumhare paas aakhri vaar tha.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek karksh, fati awaz mein bolta hai: 'kyon...? tumne mujhe khatam kyon nahin kiya? tumhare paas aakhiri baar tha.'.

panels.shot: hajun wiping blood tired human gaze
panels.action: Ha-Jun wipes scarlet blood from his split lip, looking at Baek with tired, profoundly human eyes: 'Kyunki mere bhai ne isliye jaan nahi di thi... taaki main ek darinda ban jaaun.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mera bhai isliye nahi mara taaki main darinda banu.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun wipes scarlet blood from his split lip, looking at Baek with tired, profoundly human eyes: 'Kyunki mere bhai ne isliye jaan nahi di thi... taaki main ek darinda ban jaaun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne kate hue honth se lal rang ka khoon ponchta hai, thaki hui gahri manviya aankhon se bak ko dekhta hai: 'kyonki mere bhai ne isliye jaan nahin di thi...taaki main ek darinda ban jaun.'

panels.action: Baek freezes; the sincerity in the teenager's eyes pierces through seven years of hardened military conditioning.

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Yeh aawaz... bilkul Tae-Jun jaisi thi...

panels.prose_en: Baek freezes; the sincerity in the teenager's eyes pierces through seven years of hardened military conditioning.
panels.prose_hi: Bek jam jata hai; saat saal ki kathor sainya conditioning se kishore ki aankhon mein imandari jhalakti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun pulls Tae-Jun's leather journal from his shredded blazer pocket, tossing it onto the grass in front of Baek's knees.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pulls Tae-Jun's leather journal from his shredded blazer pocket, tossing it onto the grass in front of Baek's knees.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne taaye-jun ki chamde ki patrika ko apni kati hui blazer jeb se nikala aur use bak ke ghutnon ke samne ghas par fenk diya.

panels.action: Ha-Jun: 'Apne Bureau ke sach ko padho. Wo saat saal se tum sabko bewakoof bana rahe hain.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bureau ke sach ko padho. Wo tumse jhooth bol rahe hain.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun: 'Apne Bureau ke sach ko padho. Wo saat saal se tum sabko bewakoof bana rahe hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun: 'apne bureau ke sach ko padho. woh saat saal se tum sabko bewakoof bana rahe ho.'

panels.action: Baek opens the brittle pages with bloodstained trembling fingers; official Bureau directorate seals leap out from the text.
panels.prose_en: Baek opens the brittle pages with bloodstained trembling fingers; official Bureau directorate seals leap out from the text.
panels.prose_hi: Bak khoon se sunny kampati ungaliyon se najuk panne kholta hai; adhikarik bureau nideshalay ki muharen path se bahar nikal jaati han.

panels.action: Close-up on the document: Official high-level authorizations for Project Chimera: Harvesting demonic relics for artificial soldier hybridization.

dialogue.text: 'Project Chimera: Authorized by Bureau High Command.'

panels.prose_en: Close-up on the document: Official high-level authorizations for Project Chimera: Harvesting demonic relics for artificial soldier hybridization.
panels.prose_hi: Dastavez par clos-up: project chimera ke liye adhikarik ucch-stariy pradhikaran: kritrim sainik sankaran ke liye rakshasi avsheshon ki katai.

panels.shot: baek scarred face twisting in bitter realization
panels.action: Baek's face pales: 'Director ne yeh approve kiya tha?! Saat saal pehle Tae-Jun gaddaar nahi tha... wo lab ko containment breach se bacha raha tha!'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun gaddaar nahi tha... wo lab bacha raha tha!

panels.prose_en: Baek's face pales: 'Director ne yeh approve kiya tha?! Saat saal pehle Tae-Jun gaddaar nahi tha... wo lab ko containment breach se bacha raha tha!'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ka chehra peela pad gaya: 'nirdeshak ne yeh manjoor kiya tha?' saat saal pehle taaye-jun gaddar nahin tha...vo lab ko roktham ullanghan se bacha raha tha!'

panels.action: Baek lowers his head toward the mud: 'Maine us aadmi ke chote bhai ka shikar kiya... jisne mere logon ke liye apni jaan daav par laga di.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Maine Tae-Jun ke bhai ka shikar kiya...

panels.prose_en: Baek lowers his head toward the mud: 'Maine us aadmi ke chote bhai ka shikar kiya... jisne mere logon ke liye apni jaan daav par laga di.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bak apna sir kichad ki or jhukata hai: 'maine us aadmi ke chhote bhai ka shikar kiya... jisne mere logon ke liye apni jaan daav par laga di.'

panels.action: In the distance, tactical vehicle headlights and spotlights sweep across the tennis courts; shouting operatives draw near.
panels.prose_en: In the distance, tactical vehicle headlights and spotlights sweep across the tennis courts; shouting operatives draw near.
panels.prose_hi: Duri men, samrik vahan headlights aur spotlights tennis court mein faili hui han; chillate hue sanchalak nikat aate han.

panels.action: Baek looks up urgently: 'Reinforcements aa rahi hain. Apne dost ko lekar athletic building ke piche underground tunnel se bhaag jao.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Tunnel se nikal jao! Reinforcements aa rahi hain!

panels.prose_en: Baek looks up urgently: 'Reinforcements aa rahi hain. Apne dost ko lekar athletic building ke piche underground tunnel se bhaag jao.'.
panels.prose_hi: Bek ne turant upar dekha: 'sudridhikaran aa rahi han. apne dost ko lekar athletic building ke peeche underground tunnel se bhag jao.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun blinks in mild surprise: 'Tum humein jaane de rahe ho?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tum humein jaane de rahe ho?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun blinks in mild surprise: 'Tum humein jaane de rahe ho?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun halke aashcharya se palkein jhapkate han: 'tum hamen jaane de rahe ho?'.

panels.action: Baek snaps his broken claymore back into his scabbard: 'Main report dunga ki carrier bhaag gaya aur Jun-Hyuk ne gaddaari ki. Ab jao!'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Main report sambhaal lunga. Ab jao!

panels.prose_en: Baek snaps his broken claymore back into his scabbard: 'Main report dunga ki carrier bhaag gaya aur Jun-Hyuk ne gaddaari ki. Ab jao!'.
panels.prose_hi: Bake ne apne toote hue clamor ko wapas apne myan mein rakh liya: 'mukhya report dunga ki career bhag gaya aur jun-hyuk ne gaddari ki. ab jao!'.

panels.action: Ha-Jun slings Min-Jae's arm around his neck, supporting his limping friend into the shadowed service maintenance tunnel.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slings Min-Jae's arm around his neck, supporting his limping friend into the shadowed service maintenance tunnel.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne min-je ki baanh ko apni gardan ke charon or lapet liya, aur apne langdate dost ko chhayadar seva rakhrakhav surang mein sahara diya.

panels.action: Min-Jae smiles through his cracked glasses: 'Bhai... tumne Rank-A Captain ko hara kar use hamari madad karne par majboor kar diya.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Bhai... tumne sach mein Rank-A Captain ko hara diya!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae smiles through his cracked glasses: 'Bhai... tumne Rank-A Captain ko hara kar use hamari madad karne par majboor kar diya.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je apne toote hue chashme ke madhyam se muskurate han: 'bhai... tumne rank-e captain ko hara kar use hamari madad karne par majboor kar diya.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun chuckles softly: 'Pehle apartment pahunchne do... isse pehle ki mere pair jawab de dein.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun chuckles softly: 'Pehle apartment pahunchne do... isse pehle ki mere pair jawab de dein.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun dheere se hansta hai: 'pahle apartment pahno...isse pehle ki mere jode jawab de den.'

panels.shot: kuro landing on shoulder gaze up
panels.action: Kuro alights firmly on Ha-Jun's shoulder, his crimson eyes locking onto the high library tower roof: 'Ha-Jun... koi aur bhi humein dekh raha hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... koi aur bhi humein dekh raha hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro alights firmly on Ha-Jun's shoulder, his crimson eyes locking onto the high library tower roof: 'Ha-Jun... koi aur bhi humein dekh raha hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ha-jun ke kandhe par majbuti se baithta hai, uski lal aankhen unchi library tower ki chhat par tik jaati han: 'ha-jun... koi aur bhi hamen dekh raha hai.'

panels.shot: crimson masked figure on library roof wide
panels.action: 500 meters away atop the library spire: A shadowy figure wearing a porcelain crimson demon mask and black cape rests a scythe on his shoulder.
panels.prose_en: 500 meters away atop the library spire: A shadowy figure wearing a porcelain crimson demon mask and black cape rests a scythe on his shoulder.
panels.prose_hi: 500 meter door pustakalaya shikhar ke upar: chini mitti ke gahre lal rang ka danav mukhauta aur kali topi pahane ek chhayadar aakriti apne kandhe par ek daranti rakhe hue hai.

panels.shot: demonic perception zoom on masked figure
panels.action: Through his violet demonic perception, Ha-Jun zooms across the distance: The masked figure emits ancient, terrifying Abyssal wavelength.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh Hunter nahi hai... yeh Abyss ka koi Lord hai!

panels.prose_en: Through his violet demonic perception, Ha-Jun zooms across the distance: The masked figure emits ancient, terrifying Abyssal wavelength.
panels.prose_hi: Apni baingani rakshasi dharna ke madhyam se, ha-jun door tak zoom karta hai: nakabposh aakriti prachin, bhayanak abisal tarang dairdhya ka utsarjan karti hai.

panels.action: The masked Envoy raises two gloved fingers to his temple, giving Ha-Jun a chilling, mocking salute before stepping off the ledge.
panels.prose_en: The masked Envoy raises two gloved fingers to his temple, giving Ha-Jun a chilling, mocking salute before stepping off the ledge.
panels.prose_hi: Nakabposh doot apne mandir ki or do dastaane wali ungaliyan uthata hai aur kagaar se utarne se pehle ha-jun ko ek thandi, majakiya salami deta hai.

panels.shot: kuro terror warning envoy of lords
panels.action: Kuro whispers in cold dread: 'Wo Demon Lords ka Envoy hai! Abyss ke shikari dharti par utar chuke hain!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Demon Lords ka Envoy... wo aa chuke hain!

panels.prose_en: Kuro whispers in cold dread: 'Wo Demon Lords ka Envoy hai! Abyss ke shikari dharti par utar chuke hain!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro thande bhay se fusfusata hai: 'vo danav lords ka doot hai! rasatal ke shikari dharti par utar chuke han!'.

panels.action: The masked figure dissolves into thousands of screeching black demonic bats that scatter into the night sky over Seoul.
panels.prose_en: The masked figure dissolves into thousands of screeching black demonic bats that scatter into the night sky over Seoul.
panels.prose_hi: Nakabposh aakriti hajaron chikhate hue kale rakshasi chamgadadon mein vilin ho jaati hai jo seoul ke raat ke aakash mein bikhar jaate han.

panels.shot: safe emergence on quiet residential street
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Min-Jae emerge safely onto a quiet, wet residential street, distant sirens fading behind campus walls.

dialogue.text: Unhone pehli ladai jeet li thi.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun and Min-Jae emerge safely onto a quiet, wet residential street, distant sirens fading behind campus walls.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aur min-je ek shant, gili avasiya sadak par surakshit roop se nikalte han, parisar ki diwaron ke peeche door sthit siren baj rahe han.

panels.prose_en: The Ring of Hollow Blood on Ha-Jun's finger suddenly pulses with a directional resonance beacon pointing east toward the University Observatory.

panels.action: Grand Arc 2 finale spread: Ha-Jun Kang stands under yellow sodium streetlights, his ring glowing and eyes shining violet: 'Shikar shuru ho chuka hai. Agla nishana: Bone of the Forgotten.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Shikar shuru ho chuka hai. Agla nishana: Bone of the Forgotten.

panels.prose_en: His ring glowing and eyes shining violet: 'Shikar shuru ho chuka hai. Agla nishana: Bone of the Forgotten.'.
panels.prose_hi: Uski anguthi chamak rahi thi aur aankhen baingani rang se chamak rahi thin: 'shikar shuru ho chuka hai. agla nishana: bhuli hui haddi.'
